guesses.reason: Short, dense brown ticked/mackerel tabby coat with a white bib, muzzle, and facial blaze is the classic random-bred tabby-and-white pattern.
Very large, tall, wide-set ears and a slender, wedge-leaning face hint at some lean, oriental-type ancestry.
The finely agouti-ticked brown fur on the body and large ears are faintly reminiscent of Abyssinian coloring.

breed.appearance: A slender, short-haired brown tabby-and-white cat with finely ticked, grizzled brown-gray fur on the back and shoulders, dark tabby 'M' and pencil lines on the forehead, and a crisp white chest, bib, muzzle, and narrow white blaze running up between the eyes. The ears are very large, tall, and upright with pinkish insides and fine pale ear tufts, and the face has a soft orange-tan wash at the bridge of the nose above a pink-orange nose leather. The eyes are round, wide, and pale celery green, giving an alert, earnest expression, framed by long white whiskers; the tail shows dark bands with a black tip.
breed.fun_fact: Tabby-and-white cats like Gabriel are true originals—no two have exactly the same pattern of stripes and white, so you're adopting a one-of-a-kind masterpiece!
